name: AssetsUnderConstructionPublicView
title: Reclamation Assets Under Construction
description: Reclamation has major construction activities underway across the West in support of our fundamental mission and programs to modernize and maintain infrastructure, serve underserved populations, and stay as nimble as possible in response to the requirements of drought and a changing climate. These investments are possible with the support of our operating partners, water and power customers, and through landmark bills such as the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law.
